landing2.hero: The reliable way to learn to invest.
landing2.heroTag: No gurus, no signals, no promises.
landing2.heroSub: Lumi teaches you to make your own decisions. You learn with five-minute lessons and practise with virtual money on real prices.
landing2.whySub: Nobody here sells you the formula to get rich. We teach you to think like an investor.

noTips.title: We don’t tell you what to buy
noTips.body: No signals, no portfolios to copy, no «stock that’s about to explode». You learn to analyse and you decide.

realData.title: Real data
realData.body: Real prices for stocks, ETFs, crypto and currencies, with any delay clearly shown. Nothing made up.

noRisk.title: Risk-free practice
noRisk.body: €10,000 of virtual money to make mistakes, learn and try again. Real money is never used.

course.title: A full course of {n} lessons
course.body: From what a share is to your own strategy, with quizzes and reviews so it sticks.

transparent.title: Transparency
transparent.body: We explain how everything works: where prices come from and what’s simulated. Lumi is paid for by its plans: it doesn’t connect to any broker or charge commissions.

freeFeatures: The full «Invest from today» section (units 1 to 3)
The first 3 lessons of every unit
landing2.plansSub: Final prices including VAT. Cancel any time from Settings.
landing2.legal: Lumi is an educational app. It isn’t financial advice or a personalised investment recommendation. The simulation uses virtual money: no real money is traded and it doesn’t connect to any broker, and simulated results don’t guarantee real results.
